ingredientSections.heading: Pickled Asian Pear
items: 30ml yuzu juice (from an Asian grocery or use lemon)

ingredientSections.heading: Brussels Sprouts
items: 900g Brussels sprouts, halved with the outer leaves removed

methodSections.heading: Pickled Asian Pear (prepare in advance)
steps: Peel and finely dice Asian pear.
Combine the juices, salt and chili flakes.
Marinate the pear in juice mix overnight.

methodSections.heading: Sunflower Seed Butter
steps: Spread sunflower seed out on a baking tray and roast for 15-20 minutes or until they start to take on a little colour and become fragrant.
Transfer the toasted seeds to a food processor, add the salt and puree. Slowly add the oil while blending until smooth.

methodSections.heading: Black Garlic Aioli
steps: Place the black garlic, garlic, lemon juice, salt and egg yolk in a food processor and blend until smooth.
Slowly add the canola oil to form an emulsion. If necessary, add a bit of room temperature water to thin the consistency.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as necessary.

methodSections.heading: Brussels Sprouts
steps: Bring a pot of water to a rolling boil and prepare an ice bath.
Blanch the sprouts in the boiling water for 4-5 minutes.
Remove from the heat, strain and then chill in the ice bath or under running cold water. Drain fully.
Toss the blanched sprouts in oil, season and spread on an oven tray. Roast for 20 to 25 minutes, or until they have softened a little and started to take on some colour.
Transfer to mixing bowl, season with lemon juice and toss with the sunflower butter.
Garnish with the aioli and pickled pear.
